thread:
Maya P: Quick readout from the HW partner sync — we finalized a proposed credit swap to cover marketplace launch demos. Summary below.

Leo K: Thanks. Do we have the final MDF numbers? I thought finance wanted a slab-level view.

Maya P: Beth gave us a draft: 75k USD total pilot pot. Split: 40k marketplace launch credit, 25k SI onboarding credits, 10k contingency for QBR swaps.

Beth F: confirmed in spreadsheet, see link: https://redwood-docs/internal/partnerships/hw-credit-swap-v1.xlsx :eyes: 

Jonas R: For SI onboarding, we need tier gating. Proposal: Gold SI gets 10k, Silver 5k, Bronze 2k. Any objections?

Asha G: Sounds ok but can we add a quality gate — 3 joint wins or 50k ARR pipeline within 90 days to keep the credit? Otherwise clawback.

Leo K: +1 on the clawback. Also recommend adding a comms plan for joint announcement cadence. Marketplaces teams want a pre-announce by next Tue.

Maya P: Agreed. Action items: (1) Beth to publish final MDF slab + ledger by EOD Friday; (2) Jonas to create tier gate doc and PR for canary SIs; (3) Leo to draft joint announce timeline.

Beth F: I'll publish. Will include a "swap matrix" for HW partner credits vs marketplace promos.

PartnerBot: deploy_note — spreadsheet hw-credit-swap-v1.xlsx shared with channel (view only).

Jonas R: For QBR scorecards, should we add a 'marketplace-led pipeline' metric so partners aren't penalized for pre-launch timing?

Asha G: Yes — add a temporal bucket: 'pre-launch contribution' for current quarter, then normalize post-launch.

Maya P: Noted. I'll slot that into the QBR template. Anyone want to volunteer to run a 30-min sync with marketplace PMs on Thurs?

Leo K: I can take that.

Maya P: Great — tentative meeting Thurs 10am PT. If something changes I'll update calendar.

Jonas R: One more ask — hardware partner asked about co-marketing credits vs MDF. We should clarify allowed uses in the slab doc.

Beth F: I'll add permitted use cases (demos, joint events, paid ads) and banned uses (resale to SI).

Asha G: Perfect. That should make the SI gating clearer.

Maya P: Thanks all. Will post final artifacts and I'll pull this into the QBR prep thread.
